titles.native: 魔装機神サイバスター

description:
In an enviromentally wrecked future Tokyo, a young man named Ken Ando joins an organization called DC. Little does he realize that his fate and that of Earth will be linked to a mysterious mecha from another world.

(Source: Anime News Network)
